Shanghai Municipal Council.

16th February 191 A

Sir,
    it is reported that considerable friction exists
between Military Governor Yang on the one hand and
Deputy Military Governor Lu and Li Tsoong Nyoh, Director
of the Arsenal on the other. Some time ago the
last named applied direct to Peking without consulting
the first named for permission to test some new guns.
The Central Government grants his application. When
Governor Yang heard the news he represented to the
Central Government that the testing of the guns in
Shanghai may cause a panic among the populace.
As a result of his representations the permission
granted to Li was withdrawn.
    Rebels in Shanghai are of opinion that Nanking
will declare its independence soon.
    Two men from the s.s. Albenga a German steamer
at present lying in the river, who were charged by
the Hongkew Station at the German Consulate on February
14th with being drunk and disorderly have stated that,
they with other Germans including a number of women
and children, are leaving Shanghai for America by
the s.s. China, which is due to sail on February 17th.
An advertisement has appeared in the German newspaper
to the effect that anyone wishing to leave by this
steamer should apply to the German Consul.

                Your Obedient Servant,

                Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（左侧手写批注：）
Seen by C.I.P.
Entered on m.

上海公共租界工部局。

191 年2月16日

先生：
    据报，督军杨氏与副督军卢氏及兵工厂总监李钟岳（Li Tsoong Nyoh，音译）之间存在严重摩擦。此前，后者未经前者同意，径直向北京方面申请测试新式枪支。中央政府批准了其申请。杨督军获悉此事后，向中央政府陈情称，在上海测试枪支可能会引起民众恐慌。因其陈情，授予李氏的许可已被撤销。
    上海的反叛者认为，南京不久将宣布独立。
    目前停泊于黄浦江上的德国轮船“阿尔本加”号（s.s. Albenga）上有两名男子，曾于2月14日因醉酒及行为不检被虹口巡捕房在德国领事馆指控。该二人声称，他们与其他德国人（包括多名妇女和儿童）正计划乘坐定于2月17日启航的“中国”号轮船（s.s. China）离开上海前往美国。德文报纸上已刊登一则广告，大意是欲乘此轮离境者，应向德国领事申请。

                您顺从的仆人，

                总探长。

警察总监。

（左侧手写批注：）
刑事侦缉处处长阅
录入于 m.
2月16日
